landlord: Model Fund I — Valley Freight LLC
non_disturbance: Tenant's possession is not disturbed while it is not in default beyond a cure period

quotes.tenant: This Subordination, Non-Disturbance and Attornment Agreement is made as of March 9, 2026 among Cascade Commercial Bank ("Lender"), Model Fund I — Valley Freight LLC ("Landlord") and Pinnacle Electronics ("Tenant"). (p.1)
quotes.unit: Tenant leases Unit 001, containing 2,300 square feet, at Route 9 Small Bay (the "Premises"). (§1.1)
quotes.lender: Lender has made a loan to Landlord in the original principal amount of $9,125,000, secured by a deed of trust on the property. (§1.2)
quotes.landlord: This Subordination, Non-Disturbance and Attornment Agreement is made as of March 9, 2026 among Cascade Commercial Bank ("Lender"), Model Fund I — Valley Freight LLC ("Landlord") and Pinnacle Electronics ("Tenant"). (p.1)
quotes.date: This Subordination, Non-Disturbance and Attornment Agreement is made as of March 9, 2026 among Cascade Commercial Bank ("Lender"), Model Fund I — Valley Freight LLC ("Landlord") and Pinnacle Electronics ("Tenant"). (p.1)
quotes.non_disturbance: So long as Tenant is not in default beyond any applicable cure period, Lender shall not disturb Tenant's possession of the Premises under the Lease. (§3.1)
quotes.attornment: If Lender succeeds to Landlord's interest, Tenant shall attorn to Lender as its landlord under the Lease. (§4.1)
quotes.lender_cure_days: Tenant shall give Lender notice of any Landlord default and thirty (30) days to cure it before exercising any remedy. (§5.1)
quotes.lender_liability: Lender shall not be liable for any act or omission of a prior landlord, bound by rent paid more than one month in advance, or responsible for any security deposit it has not received. (§5.2)
